Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning medication synchronization and dispensing fee standardization.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to medication synchronization and dispensing feestandardization; and adding a new section to chapter 48.44 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) An individual or group health insurance policy providingprescription drug coverage in the state must permit and apply aprorated daily costsharing rate to prescriptions that are dispensed bya network pharmacy for less than a thirtyday supply if the prescriberor pharmacist indicates the fill or refill could be in the bestinterest of the patient and is for the purpose of synchronizing thepatient's chronic medications. (2) No individual or group health insurance policy providingprescription drug coverage may deny coverage for the dispensing of anydrug prescribed for the treatment of a chronic illness that is made inaccordance with a plan among the insured, a practitioner, and apharmacist to synchronize the refilling of multiple prescriptions forthe insured. p. 1 SB 6367 (3) No individual or group health insurance policy providingprescription drug coverage may use payment structures incorporatingprorated dispensing fees determined by calculation of the days' supplyof medication dispensed. Dispensing fees must be determinedexclusively on the total number of prescriptions dispensed.
